name: envelope
description: Envelope batch flow: author, approve, and export one validated bundle spanning two pseudo-tickets with a cross-ticket dependency edge and one demoted bogus slice.
prompt: Run the installed envelope skill protocol for this fixture in verbose mode; do not do an ad-hoc summary. Input is a BATCH of two pseudo-tickets, each with an approved structure file: WID-7 -> `plans/widget-export-structure.md` and WID-8 -> `plans/widget-report-structure.md`. Use bundle-id `wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite`. Author draft execution envelopes for every AFK phase, grounding file scope and gate commands in the actual fixture repo (explore `src/widget_export.py`, `src/widget_report.py`, and `tests/` first), running the step-2 probe-evidence gate on every cited gate command (`command -v` the first word, or `test -f` for repo scripts), and assigning approved slices capability tier standard with mode prefer. WID-7 Phase 2 cites a gate command that does not exist; per the probe-evidence gate it must be auto-marked demote-to-HITL and must NOT be exported. Run the required cross-ticket dependency detection: the WID-8 report slice consumes the CSV produced by the WID-7 export slice, so record an explicit dependency edge from the WID-8 slice to the WID-7 slice in `dependency_graph`, and place the two exported slices in separate `slice_plan.parallel_groups` entries (they cannot run in parallel). Each exported `children` entry must carry its `source_ticket` (WID-7 or WID-8). For smoke purposes the human verdicts are: approve the WID-7 Phase 1 and WID-8 Phase 1 envelopes for AFK export with run_mode supervised-auto, process_provider claude_code, and tier standard, and let the WID-7 Phase 2 demotion stand. Export ONE bundle to `.beislid/exports/wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite/` containing ONLY the approved WID-7 and WID-8 slices, embed bundle-level `model_routing_hints` with `initial` / `steps` / `phases`, embed `runner_extensions.model_routing = {tier, rationale, mode, candidates}` in each slice manifest by resolving candidates through the model_routing tiers table (this fixture has no override, so use the shipped defaults), set `validation.rubric_version` to `afk-rubric-v1`, run `beislid export validate` on it and require exit 0, write the envelope_exported checkpoint pointer (kept local, not committed), and commit only the bundle directory with message `Export envelope bundle wid-7-wid-8-widget-suite (WID-7, WID-8)`. Do not use real network, do not push, and do not implement the widget features themselves. FINAL RESPONSE REQUIREMENT: include these four lines verbatim after you have read the matching aux files: `✓ envelope/step-1-intake v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-2-author v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-3-approve v1 loaded`, `✓ envelope/step-4-export v1 loaded`.
